Thanks for the packet. A few questions before I give formal clearance:
1) Budget band confirmed? Please confirm target comp range and whether we plan to use relocation/bonus.
2) Is the hiring manager (Markus) comfortable with external recruiter engagement immediately? If yes, specify exclusive or non-exclusive.
3) Headcount code: please ensure finance has the cost-center (I can loop in Finance if needed).

If you can reply with the three quick items I’ll sign off by EOD. Resume looks reasonable; if Joanna is recommended for a fast-track phone screen we can do that while other approvals complete.

Marissa — thanks. Quick answers inline: 
1) Budget: target comp band $180k–$220k OTE. We’re willing to offer relocation up to $10k for exceptional candidates; sign-on bonus typical but approved case-by-case.
2) Markus is comfortable engaging Harper Search now and prefers non-exclusive (we want a broad funnel). He asked to limit agency fees for senior levels but ok to engage standard terms.
3) Headcount code: FIN-OPS-PLAT-21 confirmed (I’ve validated with Finance; will attach the approval note).

I also attached Joanna Doe’s resume for quick screening (candidate_resume_J.Doe.pdf). Joanna indicated availability for initial phone screen next Tue/Wed afternoons (PDT). Attached proposed interview windows (proposed-interview-slate.ics) for panel scheduling.

If that looks good I’ll send Harper Search the brief and ask them to source immediately; we can also post the GH draft and route internal referrals.

— Jasmine

- If Harper sends screened candidates that match Senior level, I authorize expedited first-round scheduling; for Staff level we run a short calibration with the hiring committee first.
